spec: DACS-5 v0.7 §10.3.2/§10.5 SPA-1..SPA-8 signed participation and rating admission
decisionModel: pass admits current reputation; fail or indeterminate excludes without alternative blame
inputModel: post-reconciliation bundle plus authenticated Listing/effective-pipeline projection, exact signed participation/rating artifact, and authenticated SR-2 receipt context

vectors.name: spa-valid-negotiate-obligation
vectors.note: exact target-signed negotiate obligation admits one-sided timeout blame

vectors.name: spa-valid-vet-obligation
vectors.note: an index-zero vet obligation has an empty authenticated completed prefix

vectors.name: spa-valid-commit-obligation
vectors.note: commit admission binds the proposed agreement hash

vectors.name: spa-valid-payment-obligation
vectors.note: settle payment admission binds the committed agreement

vectors.name: spa-valid-delivery-obligation
vectors.note: settle delivery admission binds prior payment and committed agreement

vectors.name: spa-single-signed-self-blame-needs-no-external-admission
vectors.note: the blamed party's exact terminal-bundle signature is its own admission

vectors.name: spa-never-participant-missing-admission
vectors.note: absence alone proves no publication, not participation

vectors.name: spa-unqualified-bundle-absence
vectors.note: participation does not replace authoritative bundle absence

vectors.name: spa-invalid-admission-signature
vectors.note: a forged admission cannot establish participation

vectors.name: spa-wrong-admission-signer
vectors.note: the waiting party cannot sign for the alleged obligor

vectors.name: spa-wrong-job-replay
vectors.note: an admission from another job cannot be replayed

vectors.name: spa-wrong-listing
vectors.note: an admission for another listing cannot be rebound

vectors.name: spa-roster-primary-claim-mismatch
vectors.note: the admitted roster must equal the terminal bundle roster

vectors.name: spa-roster-bundle-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: identity bundle hashes are part of the exact roster

vectors.name: spa-roster-order-noncanonical
vectors.note: the admission roster has one canonical order

vectors.name: spa-wrong-obligor-role
vectors.note: an admission cannot be used to blame another role

vectors.name: spa-wrong-deadline
vectors.note: the bundle timeout and signed admission must name the same deadline

vectors.name: spa-wrong-deadline-policy
vectors.note: an unregistered clock policy cannot replace the obligor-admitted absolute deadline

vectors.name: spa-wrong-action
vectors.note: the signed owed action must equal the timeout claim

vectors.name: spa-wrong-pending-state
vectors.note: an active negotiate phase cannot be relabelled commit-pending

vectors.name: spa-phase-never-active
vectors.note: a phase outside the authenticated effective pipeline was never due

vectors.name: spa-wrong-phase-kind
vectors.note: phase kind must match the authenticated pipeline at the exact index

vectors.name: spa-incomplete-completed-prefix
vectors.note: the active-phase acknowledgement cannot omit a prior phase

vectors.name: spa-prefix-contradicts-bundle
vectors.note: the admitted prefix must match the terminal bundle's phase facts

vectors.name: spa-pay-alternative-is-not-active-handler
vectors.note: listing-only pay-alternative cannot be admitted as an executable obligation

vectors.name: spa-commit-missing-proposed-agreement-hash
vectors.note: commit admission must identify the exact proposed artifact

vectors.name: spa-settle-wrong-agreement-ref
vectors.note: settle admission cannot borrow another agreement

vectors.name: spa-invalid-session-nonce
vectors.note: the session nonce must be exactly 32 lowercase-hex bytes

vectors.name: spa-observed-cross-session-nonce-reuse
vectors.note: an observed signer nonce collision across sessions rejects replay

vectors.name: spa-missing-admission-receipt
vectors.note: a signature without finalized activation time is non-countable

vectors.name: spa-nonfinal-admission-receipt
vectors.note: accepted is not finalized activation evidence

vectors.name: spa-admission-receipt-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: the receipt must bind the exact admission content hash

vectors.name: spa-admission-writer-not-obligor
vectors.note: the alleged obligor must authorize the admission anchor

vectors.name: spa-admission-at-deadline-too-late
vectors.note: activation admission must finalize strictly before timeout

vectors.name: spa-bundle-before-deadline
vectors.note: a bundle anchored before deadline cannot prove timeout

vectors.name: spa-cross-substrate-clock
vectors.note: unrelated substrate clocks cannot establish the deadline interval

vectors.name: spa-unorderable-admission-history
vectors.note: conflicting admission receipt history cannot be cherry-picked

vectors.name: spa-unexpected-evidence-on-self-admitted-path
vectors.note: unused conditional evidence makes replay non-conforming

vectors.name: spa-admitted-at-is-advisory
vectors.note: producer time cannot override two authenticated receipt timestamps

vectors.name: spa-rating-valid-buyer-to-seller
vectors.note: a completed authenticated rate phase admits an exact seller rating

vectors.name: spa-rating-valid-seller-to-buyer
vectors.note: the inverse direction uses the same exact role gate

vectors.name: spa-rating-on-abort
vectors.note: ordinary ratings cannot be attached to an aborted session

vectors.name: spa-rating-on-failure
vectors.note: ordinary ratings cannot be attached to a failed session

vectors.name: spa-rating-completed-bundle-not-fully-signed
vectors.note: completed outcome alone does not prove target participation

vectors.name: spa-rating-phase-not-in-listing
vectors.note: a producer cannot invent a rate phase

vectors.name: spa-rating-phase-failed
vectors.note: a failed rate phase is not an eligible completed phase

vectors.name: spa-rating-phase-wrong-index
vectors.note: the bundle rate entry must occupy the listing's exact index

vectors.name: spa-rating-reference-not-in-bundle
vectors.note: a loose rating reference is not admitted

vectors.name: spa-rating-invalid-signature
vectors.note: a forged rating is excluded

vectors.name: spa-rating-wrong-job
vectors.note: a rating cannot cross sessions

vectors.name: spa-rating-non-roster-target
vectors.note: an invented target is excluded

vectors.name: spa-rating-wrong-target-role
vectors.note: targetRole must equal the target's exact authenticated role

vectors.name: spa-rating-non-roster-rater
vectors.note: only an authenticated session party may rate

vectors.name: spa-rating-self-rating
vectors.note: a party cannot rate itself

vectors.name: spa-rating-listing-unavailable
vectors.note: unavailable phase authority cannot be treated as a completed rate phase
